summary: Single-engine plane crashed and burned on a slope at Loveland Ski Area (Mt. Trelease area) after failing to clear the ridge; three people aboard killed; small wildfire started and was contained
notes: Annual log marks this as a significant mission. AP (6/30/14): Piper aircraft en route Broomfield to Moab crashed near a ski lift Monday morning.
